invariants.rationale: FileHandle objects are usually required to be non-null for subsequent operations and to access methods safely.
Processing likely requires the file to actually exist on the filesystem.
Tmx files are typically files, not directories; loading expects a regular file.
This method is named for processing TMX map files, so a .tmx extension is expected.
The input TMX file should not be empty, as an empty file likely would not define valid map data.
